result.topic_en: Calculation of the solution of the three-dimensional wave equation from a Fourier integral representation: passing to spherical coordinates in frequency space, integrating over the sphere, and arriving at a mean-value (Poisson-type) formula over spheres.

methods.what: Fourier-integral representation of the solution of the 3D wave equation with initial velocity f
Addition theorem for the angle between two directions on the sphere
Integration of a function of c cos γ over the unit sphere via an antiderivative Ψ
Reduced formula after the angular integration in frequency space
Spherical coordinates centred at (x,y,z) giving a spherical-mean (Poisson) representation
